@graph.description: Read AI pricing in 2026: Free, Pro, Enterprise and Enterprise+ plans explained with monthly and annual costs, free plan limits and team cost examples.

itemListElement.name: Read AI Pricing in 2026: Plans and Costs for US Teams

mainEntity.name: How much does Read AI cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Pro costs $19.75 per user per month on monthly billing, or $15 per month billed yearly. Enterprise costs $29.75 monthly or $22.50 yearly, and Enterprise+ costs $39.75 monthly or $29.75 yearly. Annual billing saves 25%, so a single Pro user pays $180 a year instead of $237.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Read AI's free plan covers 5 meeting transcripts, 5 reports and 5 live-note sessions a month, each up to 1 hour long. It does not include file uploads. Five meetings a month suits testing Read AI on your most important calls; anyone with daily meetings will hit the limit within the first week.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI cost money for teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Teams pay per user. A 10-person team pays $1,800 a year on Pro with annual billing. Enterprise requires at least 5 licenses. Monthly billing raises that to $2,370 a year. Enterprise for the same team costs $2,700 billed yearly, and adds audio and video playback.

mainEntity.name: What is Read AI Enterprise pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI Enterprise costs $22.50 per user per month billed yearly or $29.75 monthly, with a 5-license minimum. Enterprise+ costs $29.75 yearly or $39.75 monthly. A team of 3 that wants Enterprise features still pays for 5 seats, so small teams usually stay on Pro.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Otter Pro costs $8.33 a month billed yearly, compared with $15 for Read AI Pro. On monthly billing Otter Pro is $16.99 and Read AI Pro is $19.75. Otter's free plan also differs: 300 minutes a month at 30 minutes per call, versus Read AI's 5 meetings at up to 1 hour.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI offer a discount for annual billing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Read AI's annual billing saves 25% on every paid plan. Pro drops from $19.75 to $15 per user per month, Enterprise from $29.75 to $22.50, and Enterprise+ from $39.75 to $29.75.
